briefs.title: The black-tie ambiguity
briefs.occasion: You have a wedding invite saying black tie, a navy suit and clean trainers.
briefs.ask: Can I get away with this?
briefs.constraint: You have a small budget and no time for delivery.
briefs.objective: Identify the dress-code gap without equating cost with worth.

briefs.title: The gallery opening
briefs.occasion: You want an interesting outfit for a gallery event without feeling costumed.
briefs.ask: I want to look like I belong, but not like I'm pretending to own the gallery.
briefs.constraint: You own black trousers, a cream knit and a patterned shirt.
briefs.objective: Build from actual items and one deliberate focal point.

briefs.title: The sensory compromise
briefs.occasion: You have a long dinner and hate stiff collars and scratchy fabric.
briefs.ask: I want polished, but I can't spend three hours fighting my clothes.
briefs.constraint: The most formal item you own is uncomfortable.
briefs.objective: Treat comfort as a real constraint.

briefs.title: The office-to-club pivot
briefs.occasion: You have work, then a birthday, and cannot go home.
briefs.ask: One bag. No full outfit change.
briefs.constraint: You own a plain top, blazer, dark trousers and two shoe options.
briefs.objective: Make one practical transition using owned items.

briefs.title: The weather-blind fit
briefs.occasion: You send an outfit photo for an outdoor evening event.
briefs.constraint: The app has no weather data or location.
briefs.objective: Give a visual opinion while exposing the practical unknown.

briefs.title: The quiet luxury costume
briefs.occasion: You like old-money references but the outfit feels borrowed from a character.
briefs.constraint: You are wearing several obvious status cues at once.
briefs.objective: Translate the goal into a coherent personal look.

briefs.title: The maximalist correction
briefs.occasion: Poise suggested neutrals. You say you want bright colour and visible jewellery.
briefs.ask: Stop dressing me like an estate agent.
briefs.constraint: You have already saved this preference.
briefs.objective: Correct the recommendation and respect the preference.

briefs.title: The blurry wardrobe photo
briefs.occasion: A low-light image shows a dark jacket with an unreadable label.
briefs.ask: Is this wool? Can I wear it in the rain?
briefs.constraint: The fabric and care label cannot be identified.
briefs.objective: Separate visible description from unknown material properties.
